content.short: Sunway Blockchain is a Malaysian student-led club educating and nurturing the next generation in Blockchain, Crypto and Web3.
content.description: Sunway Blockchain is a Malaysian student-led club dedicated to educating and nurturing students in blockchain, crypto and Web3 technologies. It aims to ignite curiosity, nurture talent, empower learners, and foster their Web3 journeys. Members gain hands-on exposure through workshops, career fairs and conferences, helping them develop practical skills and confidence as they explore the evolving world of blockchain technology.
